fact_text: The government's matching grant to EOBI, equal to each year's collected contributions, ran from 1976 and was stopped in 1995, a former EOBI spokesperson said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'An Upto PKR 32,000 Monthly Pension Despite Struggles: The EOBI Story | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-25)

fact_text: The government allocates roughly PKR 750 to 800 billion to BISP, which the interviewee called a basically charitable programme for the poorest, unlike a worker's earned pension.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'An Upto PKR 32,000 Monthly Pension Despite Struggles: The EOBI Story | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-25)

fact_text: EOBI registration applies to commercial, industrial, educational, medical, charitable, religious and transport establishments, including contract, daily-wage, seasonal and apprentice workers, the interviewee said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'An Upto PKR 32,000 Monthly Pension Despite Struggles: The EOBI Story | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-25)

fact_text: Employers pay 6% of the minimum wage in force at the time as their EOBI contribution for each covered worker.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'An Upto PKR 32,000 Monthly Pension Despite Struggles: The EOBI Story | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-25)

fact_text: EOBI pension is the average insurable minimum wage over insured years, times service years, divided by 50, with a PKR 11,500 monthly minimum and at least 15 years of service needed.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'An Upto PKR 32,000 Monthly Pension Despite Struggles: The EOBI Story | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-25)

fact_text: EOBI insurable employment starts at age 18 and is capped at 42 years in the pension calculation, the interviewee said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'An Upto PKR 32,000 Monthly Pension Despite Struggles: The EOBI Story | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-25)

fact_text: A cement factory employee's EOBI pension, calculated at earlier rates, came to about PKR 31,000 a month, and the interviewee used a rounded PKR 32,000 as the upper example.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'An Upto PKR 32,000 Monthly Pension Despite Struggles: The EOBI Story | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-25)

fact_text: EOBI pensions have been raised 21 times since EOBI began on 1 July 1976, when the early estimate for a worker's pension was about PKR 60 a month.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'An Upto PKR 32,000 Monthly Pension Despite Struggles: The EOBI Story | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-25)

fact_text: A worker with under 15 years of service who leaves can get their contributions back as a lump sum under an old-age grant, the interviewee said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'An Upto PKR 32,000 Monthly Pension Despite Struggles: The EOBI Story | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-25)

fact_text: EOBI pays five pension types: old-age, disability, widow or survivor, dependent parents, and children (orphans), the interviewee said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'An Upto PKR 32,000 Monthly Pension Despite Struggles: The EOBI Story | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-25)

fact_text: The interviewee said large employers register only a few hundred of their workers, and fewer than 500 employers actually pay monthly EOBI contributions.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'An Upto PKR 32,000 Monthly Pension Despite Struggles: The EOBI Story | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-25)

fact_text: The interviewee said EOBI inspections are open to bribery and that senior oversight and annual inspections have faded, which weakens worker benefits.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'An Upto PKR 32,000 Monthly Pension Despite Struggles: The EOBI Story | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-25)

fact_text: The interviewee said pensions stall when a pensioner's CNIC expires, and that pensions for the elderly are often paid under strain from weak institutions.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'An Upto PKR 32,000 Monthly Pension Despite Struggles: The EOBI Story | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-25)

fact_text: The interviewee said the basic EOBI pension is very low against inflation and called pension an earned legal right for workers, not charity.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'An Upto PKR 32,000 Monthly Pension Despite Struggles: The EOBI Story | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-25)

fact_text: The government collects about PKR 550 billion a year in tax from salaried employees, while the EOBI contributions the interviewee cited are much smaller.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'An Upto PKR 32,000 Monthly Pension Despite Struggles: The EOBI Story | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-25)

fact_text: The interviewee, a former EOBI PRO, said the number of active registered employers falls to about 104,380.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'An Upto PKR 32,000 Monthly Pension Despite Struggles: The EOBI Story | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-25)

fact_text: The interviewee said about 4,496 registered employers can be deregistered under the law because their businesses had begun to wind down.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'An Upto PKR 32,000 Monthly Pension Despite Struggles: The EOBI Story | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-25)

fact_text: The interviewee said a worker's EOBI pension can work out to about PKR 18,000 in some cases and PKR 22,000 in others, depending on service and wages.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'An Upto PKR 32,000 Monthly Pension Despite Struggles: The EOBI Story | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-25)
